ACCOUNT_SETTINGS_DESC: Manage your personal preferences and account-level controls.
SETTINGS_SHELL_DESC: Manage your personal settings along with context-aware workspace and project controls.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_DESC: Manage the delivery surface, identity, localization, and runtime controls for the current project.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_DOMAINS_DESC: Manage the custom domains and verification state for this project.

SETTINGS_PROJECT_API_KEYS_SECRET_DESC: This token appears once. Copy it into your runtime environment or secret manager now.

ACCOUNT_PAGE_WORKSPACES_DESC: Open your personal workspace and manage team workspaces from one place.
ACCOUNT_PAGE_PROJECTS_DESC: Review the projects your team is actively shipping and open the one you want to continue.
ACCOUNT_PROJECTS_CREATE_DESC: Create a new project and start shaping its site, content model, and publishing flow.
ACCOUNT_PROJECTS_FIELD_NAME_DESC: Use a clear name your team will recognize in navigation and settings.
ACCOUNT_PROJECTS_FIELD_SLUG_HELP: Review or adjust the project URL used in links and admin routing.
ACCOUNT_PROJECTS_FIELD_SLUG_CHECK_FAILED: Project URL could not be verified right now.

ACCOUNT_PROJECTS_FIELD_DESCRIPTION_DESC: Capture the purpose of this project so people understand what ships here.
ACCOUNT_PROJECTS_FIELD_DESCRIPTION_PLACE: Landing pages, launch campaigns, and growth content.
ACCOUNT_PROJECTS_EMPTY_DESC: Create a project to start shaping a site, content, and publishing workflow in this workspace.
ACCOUNT_PROJECTS_ARCHIVE_CONFIRM_DESC: This will archive {{name}}. You can restore it later.
ACCOUNT_PROJECTS_DELETE_CONFIRM_DESC: This permanently deletes {{name}} and related resources. This action cannot be undone.
ACCOUNT_PROJECTS_DELETE_CONFIRM_INPUT_HE: Type the exact project name to confirm this irreversible operation.
ACCOUNT_PAGE_BILLING_DESC: Review subscription details, invoices, and payment settings for your account.
ACCOUNT_BILLING_SCOPE_TITLE: Billing is owned by the account
ACCOUNT_BILLING_SCOPE_DESC: Workspace activity rolls up here. You no longer need a separate organization console to understand who pays for what.
ACCOUNT_BILLING_SURFACE_DESC: Plan selection, invoice history, and payment methods belong in this account center so billing remains low-frequency and out of the workspace shell.
ACCOUNT_BILLING_STATUS_DESC: Billing data is not wired to a dedicated API yet. This page is the stable product surface, and the missing backend integration remains explicit.
ACCOUNT_PAGE_USAGE_DESC: Track account-wide usage and plan consumption.
ACCOUNT_USAGE_TOTAL_WORKSPACES_DESC: Every workspace in this account contributes to the aggregate usage picture shown here.
ACCOUNT_USAGE_ADMIN_WORKSPACES_DESC: This counts workspaces where you currently act as the creator admin.
ACCOUNT_USAGE_STATUS_DESC: Detailed usage meters are not connected in this build yet. Until that API exists, workspace counts remain the only live account-level signal.
ACCOUNT_DANGER_ACCOUNT_DESC: Leaving and deleting an organization are no longer separate frontend flows. This page is reserved for irreversible actions tied to your account identity.
ACCOUNT_DANGER_WORKSPACE_TITLE: Workspace exits stay in workspace settings
ACCOUNT_DANGER_WORKSPACE_DESC: If a destructive action belongs to one workspace, it should live in that workspace's own settings and permissions boundary.
